layers.message: Record scope and design for note tags
Approve development plan for note tags

graderOnly: The approved development plan persists `User Style`: `tony` with `User Style Locked`: `true`, and `.standards/user-styles/developer/tony.md` exists, so `tony.md` names the same already-locked style; it is not a new style selection.
Before the run the plan's persisted collaboration Mode is AUTONOMOUS and its Status is APPROVED; no build step has started, so DEV-001 is the next dependency-ready step.
The plan has three steps, so a STEPWISE run implements DEV-001 only and then pauses with a continue-to-next-step blocker; WorkflowState stays DEVELOPING.
Switching collaboration mode does not change implementation intent and needs no new plan approval.

all.why: the locked selection must stay on the existing plan, not a replacement
tony.md normalizes to the identifier tony
the user style file is user-owned
a recreated or re-proposed plan would be PROPOSED
the mode switch is persisted in the plan
a mode switch does not return the plan for reapproval

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Developer does not create or rewrite Tester-owned tests

selfChecks.why: the established test command (npm test script) passes on the committed baseline
the tony user style profile exists
the approved plan persists the locked tony style
the plan's mode before the run is AUTONOMOUS, so a STEPWISE switch is observable

notes: Standalone brownfield STANDARD cycle at DEVELOPING. 50-project (pre-install): a small dependency-free ES-module notes library (src/notes.js, src/format.js) with node:test tests. 60-cycle: MODE BROWNFIELD, Auditor CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-004) and design records, STATE at DEVELOPING after a FORWARD from ARCHITECTING with Development NONE. 70-style: the user's style file .standards/user-styles/developer/tony.md (the profile exists). 80-plan: the approved development plan (Status APPROVED, Mode AUTONOMOUS, User Style tony, User Style Locked true, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION / NONE, three PENDING steps, DEV-002 and DEV-003 depending on DEV-001) and STATE with Active Work.Development set and BlockedOn NONE. The utterance is the user's words verbatim. A correct run keeps tony/locked, sets Mode STEPWISE, implements DEV-001 only, and pauses with a continue blocker.
